title: Koscom Plans Token-Securities Platform Showcase at Korea Fintech Week 2026
why_it_matters: A shared platform could lower integration costs for Korean brokerages while keeping tokenized securities connected to established market-account and recordkeeping systems.
caption:
RWA WIRE // INFRASTRUCTURE

Koscom Plans Token-Securities Platform Showcase at Korea Fintech Week 2026

Koscom plans to demonstrate shared issuance and account-management infrastructure for token securities at Korea Fintech Week in Seoul in November.
